name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 8 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 52 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2025-12-18, at wavelengths from 0.79 to 4.90 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
